name: SIAGA Architecture Map

summary.product: Operational dashboard for Taruna Prima multi-cabang school/care workflows
summary.frontend: React 18 SPA served by Vite in development and by Express static hosting in production
summary.backend: Express API with JWT auth, better-sqlite3 persistence, image uploads, and role/cabang scoping

rootScripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

domains.name: Identity and access
notes: Role and cabang scope enforced in middleware and workflow helpers

domains.name: Master data
notes: Multi-cabang structure with operational configuration per cabang, jenjang, and paket

domains.name: Student lifecycle
notes: Enrollment snapshots preserve cabang, jenjang, rombel, and paket history

domains.name: Attendance and pickup
notes: QR pickup scan moves students to Menunggu; teacher/admin confirms Pulang

domains.name: Daily record and parent portal
notes: Draft/published daily records, attachments, comments, read receipts, notifications

domains.name: Billing
notes: Tarif, generated charges, partial payments, allocation, invoice foundations

domains.name: Auditability
notes: Important workflow changes write actor/action/entity/cabang/before/after metadata

roles.backend: All cabang; creates cabang, tariffs, users, billing, student operations
Cabang-scoped staff/wali/siswa, operational config, billing generation/payment
Dashboard and read-heavy cabang oversight; some daily record write permissions exist backend-side
Daily records, attendance check-in/keterangan, comments, pickup scan/pulang
Published daily record history and comments for linked children

flows.name: Login and session
steps: LoginView posts credentials to /api/auth/login
Backend verifies bcrypt password and signs JWT
Token is stored in localStorage as siaga_token
App calls /api/auth/me on boot and routes by role
Requests attach Authorization: Bearer token

flows.name: Student administration
steps: Admin/Admin Cabang creates siswa
Backend creates siswa row plus active siswa_enrollment
Scope helpers constrain future reads by cabang, rombel, or wali_siswa
Enrollment changes close old records and create a dated new enrollment

flows.name: Daily record
steps: Guru/Kepsek/Admin views /api/daily-record/today
Guru saves draft to laporan_harian
Optional photos go through multer memory storage and sharp compression
Publish sets published timestamps and notifies linked wali
Wali opens history/detail and can comment back

flows.name: Pickup
steps: Gerbang scans penjemput QR
Backend validates active penjemput and student cabang access
Absensi status becomes Menunggu with jam_tunggu
Guru/Admin confirms pulang for selected siswa_ids

flows.name: Billing
steps: Admin defines biaya_tarif by cabang, tahun_ajaran, jenjang, jenis, nama
Admin/Admin Cabang generates monthly or kegiatan tagihan idempotently
Payments create pembayaran and pembayaran_alokasi rows
Tagihan status moves open, sebagian, or lunas based on allocations

frontend.routing: State-driven role navigation, not React Router

notableFindings: 4 route modules exist but are not mounted by backend/server.js: guru, kelas, laporan, rekap.
5 frontend API calls reference methods missing from frontend/src/api.js, all currently in components such as LaporanTab.
Runtime artifacts are present in the repo tree, including SQLite database files and uploaded images; these are mapped as runtime state rather than source architecture.
No dedicated test files were found in the app source tree during this scan.
